posts.title: You must charge your iPhone to 100%

slides.text: You must charge your iPhone to 100%
THE TRUTH — Lithium batteries age fastest at the extremes. Charging to 80% for daily use keeps meaningful capacity for years instead of months.

posts.title: Remove junk and bloatware safely

slides.text:
Remove junk and bloatware safely
Settings > Apps > Installed apps
Uninstall trialware and toolbars you never open
Run Disk Cleanup afterwards to free the space
For stubborn apps, use their own uninstaller first
Never download 'PC cleaner' tools — they cause more harm than good.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Remove junk and bloatware safely 🛠️

1. Settings > Apps > Installed apps
2. Uninstall trialware and toolbars you never open
3. Run Disk Cleanup afterwards to free the space
4. For stubborn apps, use their own uninstaller first
5. Never download 'PC cleaner' tools
     ✓ they cause more harm than good.
